# packs.haruhime.moe

> Source for https://packs.haruhime.moe, a browser-first osu! mappool pack builder. Paste beatmap IDs, osu! links or spreadsheet rows, arrange the maps into slots, download the pool as one zip or a torrent built in the browser, and share it with a pack key or a saved short link. Players can also add a pack's maps to their osu! collections: the browser edits osu!stable's collection.db or builds a zip for osu!lazer's import. The site also lists public packs and has a JSON API. It never hosts beatmap files. Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 7 and MongoDB, run with Bun. MIT license. The live site serves its own llms.txt at https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms.txt; that one is the canonical guide to the pages, guides, API and data. This file covers the repository.

## Site

- [llms.txt on the live site](https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): the canonical guide to the site's pages, guides, search index, API and legal pages, built from the same content registry as the pages
- [llms-full.txt on the live site](https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms-full.txt): every doc, guide and legal page as one Markdown file
- [packs.haruhime.moe](https://packs.haruhime.moe/): the live site
- [API docs](https://packs.haruhime.moe/docs/api.md): the packs API as plain Markdown (keys, rate limits, errors, the pack object, every endpoint)
- [OpenAPI document](https://packs.haruhime.moe/api/v1/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 for every /api/v1 endpoint, built from the route handlers' zod schemas

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe#readme): what packs does, its features, stack, the shared packages it uses and where to get help
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions, invariants (no file hosting, pack keys, accounts, public packs, the pools service endpoint, pack stats, osu! collections) and file layout for AI coding agents
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, environment variables, tests and the checks a PR must pass
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability

## Source

- [content/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/tree/main/content): the guides, the API docs and the legal pages, as MDX
- [src/app/api/v1/](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/tree/main/src/app/api/v1): the public API's route handlers
- [src/lib/openapi.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/lib/openapi.ts): builds the OpenAPI document
- [src/utils/llms-txt.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/utils/llms-txt.ts): the notes and API links of the live /llms.txt (rendered by @haruhimemoe/next-kit/docs contentLlmsTxt from the content registry, src/constants/content.ts)
- [src/constants/seo.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/src/constants/seo.ts): the site as the shared SEO helpers see it (titles and the short " · packs" suffix, preview image, the haruhime.moe organization)
- [.env.example](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe/blob/main/.env.example): every environment variable, with what it's for

## Elsewhere

- [@haruhimemoe/pool](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool): the mappool shape, mod rules, pasted-pool parsing and the pack key codec packs uses
- [@haruhimemoe/mirror](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/mirror): the client for the hinai beatmap mirror
- [@haruhimemoe/osu](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu): osu! API v2 shapes, the server client, and the collection.db reader and writer behind "Add to osu! collection"
- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): the React components and theme the site is built from
- [@haruhimemoe/next-kit](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/next-kit): the server plumbing and the SEO helpers (metadata, robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, llms.txt) packs shares with the other haruhime.moe sites
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): generates the logos, icons and link preview, and draws each public pack's preview card
- [haruhime Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin): skills for osu! tools, including one for packs and its API
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://pools.haruhime.moe): the osu! tournament mappool builder, in beta. Hosts search maps under a mod, check a pool against the content rules and build it with co-editors; past tournament pools (from hosts, community submissions and sources like otdb) are there as reference. It publishes pools to packs as packs owned by haruhime pools
- [bb.haruhime.moe](https://bb.haruhime.moe): haruhime's osu! BBCode editor, for userpages and tournament forum posts
- [haruhime.moe](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe): the home page for haruhime's osu! tools
- [Discord](https://haruhime.moe/discord): our public Discord server
